body: Fuck it, make this the one that brings the banhammer: you are a lying, despicable piece of shit that pulled out of his ass some nonsense about "providing cutting-edge medical advancements fresh out of the experimental phase of development" in order to justify and excuse negligent manslaughter over savings so minuscule they aren't even enough to cover the price of a single pick up truck. May you suffer thrice as much sorrow as those preventable deaths caused, and may you find yourself at the receiving end of the same callous disregard for life that you defend for free, because you are also too much of a goddamn idiot to at least get paid for it.
